package consumer

import (
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api/endpoint"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api/input"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api/openapi"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api/output"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/auth"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/serializers"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/web"
	"strconv"
)

type body struct{ Name input.Presence[string] }
type resource struct {
	ID   string
	Name string
}

func prepare(authentication api.Authentication, requestBody input.Body[body], response output.Output[resource]) ([]openapi.Operation, []openapi.NamedSchema, error) {
	path := endpoint.Resolve(endpoint.Sequence(endpoint.PathInt64("id"), endpoint.PathString("key")),
		func(_ *web.Request, actor auth.Principal, value endpoint.Pair[int64, string]) (resource, error) {
			return resource{ID: strconv.FormatInt(value.First, 10), Name: actor.ID() + value.Second}, nil
		})
	prepared, err := endpoint.New(authentication, endpoint.Config[endpoint.Pair[resource, body], resource]{
		Route:     web.Route{Name: "items:update", Method: "PUT", Path: "/items/<int64:id>/<str:key>/"},
		Admission: endpoint.Authenticated(),
		Input:     endpoint.Sequence(path, endpoint.NoQuery(endpoint.JSONBody("Body", requestBody, serializers.ModeFull, "Body."))),
		Output:    response, Success: []endpoint.Status{{Code: 200, Description: "Updated."}},
		Handle: func(request *web.Request, _ auth.Principal, value endpoint.Pair[resource, body]) (output.Prepared[resource], error) {
			if name, present := value.Second.Name.Get(); present {
				value.First.Name = name
			}
			return response.Prepare(request.Context(), 200, value.First)
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	return endpoint.Collect([]endpoint.Endpoint{prepared})
}
